verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that GitCafe brings repositories from GitHub with their issues, pull requests, reviews and comments, with optional one-way or two-way sync. This matches every element of the story, and the onboarding flow is documented as choosing Sync with GitHub at sign-up. Missing for 10: import sources beyond GitHub (e.g. GitLab, Bitbucket), detail on import fidelity and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
